title: Exactly solvable non-unitary conformal interfaces in unitary CFTs
abstract: Exactly solvable lattice constructions of non-unitary conformal interfaces embedded in unitary CFTs, with biorthogonal boundary-state data and complex effective central charges computed in closed form.
key_claims: Provides exactly solvable lattice models realizing non-unitary conformal interfaces inside unitary CFTs.
Extracts biorthogonal boundary-state data and complex effective central charges exactly -- closed-form benchmarks for non-unitary conformal data extraction.
Supplies lattice-exact validation targets for any numerical method (e.g. a non-Hermitian MERA) claiming to recover biorthogonal/non-unitary conformal data.
relevance_note: ACTIONABLE. Direct methodological tooling for the HYP-028 non-Hermitian program: the planned non-Hermitian MERA route to Yang-Lee M(2,5) needs exact benchmarks for biorthogonal conformal-data extraction, and this paper provides precisely that machinery (lattice-exact non-unitary interfaces with known biorthogonal boundary-state data and complex effective central charges). Route to HYP-028 as a validation-suite reference before any non-Hermitian MERA run. Pairs with PAPER-2026-128 (biorthogonal observable layer) and PAPER-2026-133 (periodic-chain Yang-Lee extraction).
anchor_contradiction: None. Tooling/benchmark paper; no contact with alpha=4 (=2*Delta_T), transport residual, or chi-bound anchors.
